race.description: Sctc Champion Apprentice - Dale Cole Hcp (C1)
race.comment: Tough race. TESSY TEE (6) backed-up quickly when back in trip for an improved on-pace third over 1100m at Goulburn in C3 grade. Can hold a forward position and go close in this easier contest. ELLISMAYNE (3) was a month between runs when he came out quickly to go under narrowly in a tight finish when third  over 1210m at the Sapphire Coast. Looks hard to stop again from the inside gate. OCTOBER STAR (2) slow into stride at latest and never got into the contest with a below par sixth over 1200m at Gosford. Has to deal with a sticky gate and should find this more to his liking on a firmer track. KOOL KADE (11) winkers go on today after he returned with a battling seventh over 1000m at Kembla Grange. Ready for the extra trip in this weaker race. The chances don't end there.
